catalog.title: 1972 Seiko Catalog Vol.1
catalog.note: JDM full-line catalogue (men's, ladies', fancy, stopwatch and railway watches). Each caption prints ●model, jewels (石, mechanical models only) and number, e.g. '●52KCM 25石 010' -> ref 52KCM-010 (the printed line is kept in `code`; ladies' numbers carry an R-/S-/A- prefix, e.g. 11SL-R-117), then the model name and feature lines (translated into `specs`/`notes`), the case material·WR line (SS, HSS, SGP, GC, WGP, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, PDP, PMP, NSA/NSAG super-hard alloy, SILV, AGF/AWGF/WGF, 14K·WG, 18K, ALM light alloy, CRP; WR water-resistant, RP rainproof) with the list price (円), and a bracketed case-dial number (600-600) kept as `caseDialCode`. Where the model is a four-digit number (6185, 6800, 2220, 2559, 2201, 6117, 6618, 1944) it is the movement and is stored as `caliber`; family codes (56GAW, 52KCM, 61-5A, 11SL, 22MLQ, 88ST …) leave it blank. No CCCC-NNNN case refs and no bracelet/strap codes are printed; the pictured strap or bracelet is described in `notes`. Where one caption lists two materials, both prices are kept in `price` and `notes` says which one is pictured. Scan index 0 is the cover; scan n shows printed page n-2.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders of all 142 scan pages (Oct 2026), one record per pictured watch in reading order, verified against full-resolution caption crops and cross-checked with the PDF text layer; one photo box per caption bullet from a grid-cell detector plus 18 hand-set boxes, all checked on per-page check sheets.
